learning_outcomes.text: Defines the fundamental problem and concepts of microeconomics
Applies economic thinking to real-life phenomena.
Identifies basic market equilibrium through supply and demand analysis.
Interprets the concepts of price and elasticity.
Analyzes market equilibrium and the impact of changing factors.
Gains knowledge of production theory and costs.

syllabus_topics: Definition of Economics, Fundamental Economic Problems, and Economic Actors
Economic Thinking, Decision Making, Economic Methods, Normative and Positive Approaches
Scarcity, Choice and Utility, Opportunity Cost, Monetary Cost, Production Possibilities
Alternative Economic Systems, Total Utility, Marginal Utility
Demand and Demand Function, Demand Curve, Factors Affecting Demand, Shifts in Demand
Supply and Supply Function, Supply Curve, Factors Affecting Supply, Shifts in Supply
Interaction of Supply and Demand, Market Equilibrium, Curve Shifts, and Equilibrium
Elasticity, Price Elasticity of Demand, Factors Affecting Price Elasticity of Demand, Income Elasticity of Demand
Applications of Supply and Demand, Producer Surplus, Consumer Surplus
Production and Costs, Production, Production Function, Short-Run and Long-Run Production
Costs, Cost Function, Long-Run and Short-Run Costs
Perfect Competition Market and Its Characteristics, Market Mechanism
assessment_rules: The final success grade is calculated from the Semester Learning Activities (Midterm Examination) contributing 40% and End of Semester Learning Activities (Final Examination) contributing 60%. There is also a makeup exam (Bütünleme Sınavı) whose contribution is not specified.
bibliography: Karl E. Case, Ray C. Fair, Sharon & M. Oster (2015) Ekonominin İlkeleri, (12. Baskıdan Çeviri) Palme Yayınevi
Robert Frank & Ben Bernanke (2017) Ekonominin Temelleri, Literatür Yayınları- Çeviri 2. Baskı
Bradley R. Schiller, Karen Gebhardt (2021). Ekonomiye Giriş, Nobel Yayıncılık (Türkçe Çeviri)
